body.name: \(\Xi\)
body.construction: For \(p\geq3\), let \(\Xi=(M,\iota,\mathcal T,\mathfrak G,\preceq_{\mathfrak G},(\Theta_{\boldsymbol d},\Theta^{\mathrm{in}}_{\boldsymbol d})_{\boldsymbol d\in\mathfrak G},q,W,\rho,r_{\mathrm{id}},R,s_{\mathrm{tail}},a_{\mathrm{TM}},b_{\max},c_{\max},\pi_{\mathrm{ar}},\alpha,w_{\max},N_{\max})\), where \(\mathfrak G\neq\varnothing\), every parameter and inference box is nonempty, every displayed numerical entry is rational, \(W\) is rational positive definite, \(\rho\in\Delta_J^{\mathbb Q}=\{r\in\mathbb Q_+^J:\sum_{j=1}^{J}r_j=1\}\), and \(\pi_{\mathrm{ar}}=(b_0,\Delta b,b_{\mathrm{cap}},\mathtt{out})\) has \(b_0,\Delta b\in\mathbb N\), \(b_{\mathrm{cap}}\geq b_0\), and fixes binary precision escalation with downward and upward directed rounding.
